baseline_service_control.interpretation: Functional and actual RAM-transfer checks passed. The old byte-pool manager attributes host hits to EXTERNAL_UNSPECIFIED; candidate explicitly returns HOST. Original failed assertion is preserved, not relaxed.

memory_interpretation: Stable over three candidate starts and two baseline starts under identical .93 utilization and 131072 context. Extra capacity comes from a larger measured profile budget, not changed recurrent/draft reservations; this is not a claim of lower total allocated VRAM.

baseline-01.limitations: Five-second observations, not instantaneous peak proof. RSS includes shared mappings; per-process high-water marks are not simultaneous totals. Driver memory deduplicated by device/client. Foreground runs have no systemd swap cap; actual observed swap is reported.

cache_replay_limit: All 45 document cold/warm pairs are token-identical per candidate run. Varied chat is not bitwise cache invariant in either release; baseline reproduces the token-17 B1 branch and cold B1 outputs match across releases. On-topic output and API validity are not broad model-quality evidence.
statistical_limits: Three repeats per cell, synthetic workloads and one host. Descriptive medians, not p99, statistical equivalence, or a guarantee for other models/graphs/co-resident GPU workloads. Intermittent throttle flags and transient preemptions are retained in evidence.

kernel_upgrade.decision: Keep the qualified Torch 2.14 pair. Newer investigated kernels require Torch 2.15 and are not a drop-in upgrade; no source-traced compelling automatic gain for the current eager dense Qwen/KVarN path.

host_settings: Unchanged. New scheduler interval and Triton GDN choices remain unpromoted experiments; current eager V2, explicit target/draft cache types, async offload, concurrency and memory budgets retained.
publication_and_deployment: No remote publication, production pin change, or system switch performed.
